column2: All riiight, let's go!
Here they come... Let's do this!
The vanguard led by Getter Robo has set out for the Hill of Beginnings! They've begun engaging the giant black fiends!
So it has begun at last!
Hell Villa's transfer is complete!
So far, everything is going to plan!
Dammit! The castle's surrounded by a barrier!? Getter can't get near the castle! Do something, assault team!
Getter's fighting the giant black fiends. But it looks like it can't get near the castle...
The castle seems to be protected by some kind of barrier. But the rioters are inside the castle too, right? Maybe there's an entrance somewhere...
All right! Now Getter Robo can get into the castle!
Storming the castle!
Oh no!
It's terrible, Dr. Saotome!\n\nGetter Robo has been captured by the enemy!
And the assault team...!?
We've lost contact with the assault team too!
No...
We must think of a countermeasure quickly...
It's a grim situation, but you must not leave here under any circumstances! Don't go walking into the enemy's trap!
The rioters have appeared!\n\nThey're marching on the residential area!
So they've finally come... Akira-kun! Take {p} somewhere safe!
Let's go, {p}!
B-but...!
Move it!

Don't you dare leave this room!

I'm going back to Dr. Saotome.

When new information comes in, I'll come tell you.
Akira-kun...
Hang in there, {p}! I wanna fight too, you know!
Akira, who became Devilman, is holding himself back from fighting. Do you know why, {p}?
Akira wants to protect you.\n\nI envy you.
What are you doing, {p}! Get back to your room!
Go back to your room, {p}-kun! If anything changes in the battle, I'll be sure to tell you!
After all I told him, where'd that {p} run off to!? ...Hm?
Don't tell me he...?
...So that's how it is.
Y-you!?
{p}, you got completely fooled by this guy.
Showing {p} the rioters, trying to separate {p} from us... I knew you were fishy!
So you noticed... But I won't let you interfere!
Sorry, Akira-kun... I...
I know, {p}.
Now, shall we go?
To the Hill of Beginnings!
Yeah!
...These streets look familiar, don't they?
This is near Miki-chan's house!
Whaaat! That's impossible...!
Ahahahaha! Burn, buuurn!
Anyone who defies the Demon King dies!
Feel it! The Demon King's wrath!
The rioters are destroying the town...
I've gotta protect Miki-chan!
Masa! Hang in there! What happened to Miki-chan!?
F-Fudo... Sorry, man...
Akira-kun! Hurry!
Tare-chan!
Big bro Akira...\n\nWh-why is this happening to us...?
Even a little kid like this... It's too cruel!
Miki-chan!
Akira, it's dangerous!
But Miki-chan's...!
She's already...
Don't stop me, Ryo!
Look out!
MIKI!!\n\nRAAAAAAAH!
My hope for living... my reason to live... I've lost it all...
...That was how the world is meant to be.
Wh-who's there!?
How the world is meant to be...!?
You're a victim of the Dimension Chain too, Akira-kun. What you just saw is something that is going to happen in your world...
What? How do you know my name...?
Answer me!
Could it be... you're {s}!? That's it, right? You're {s}, aren't you!?
{s}?\n\nIf it were {s}, why wouldn't she show herself!?
Miki...?
If the Demon King does not link the worlds... that tragedy is certain to happen...
Then is Miki alive!?
Only the Demon King knows that.\n\nBut this much is true: only the Demon King can prevent the tragedy.
Only the Demon King can prevent the tragedy...
Tell me! Showing us illusions like this... What on earth does the Demon King want!?
The Demon King wants his ideas to be accepted, you see... If you cooperate, the tragedy you just saw can be prevented...
Then Miki-chan doesn't have to die?
Don't worry, Akira-kun. The tragedy won't happen...
How can you be so sure?
Because {p} is already in the Demon King's hands... This is a prison made for {p}. One of countless dimensions, linked here... a Dimension Prison!
A Dimension Prison!?
We can't... get out of here?
The eclipse is almost here... Until then, you're a prisoner of the Dimension Prison. The fate of the world... of your friends... is as good as finished...
No... no...
The Demon King knew you'd get out of there eventually. He just used his minions to help you along...
So I was just dancing in the palm of the Demon King's hand...
No one can defy the Demon King...
Enough already! Let us out of here!
It's no use. You can't get out of the Dimension Prison. Not unless someone works the mechanism from outside.\n\nI... tried it too...
Then you really are {s}!?
You are, aren't you...!?
No, I am the "Moon of destruction"! And you are the "Sun of rebirth"! When the time comes, we'll both be let out of here...
